payload.title: Test Qwen-native vision-feature reuse and token-authenticated Retina ingress on the final target VPS
payload.work_clay: Implement an H1-grade matched visual benchmark around the current Qwen3.5-4B abliterated Q4_K_M + mmproj lane on the Frank v0.1 target VPS. Capture the libmtmd image embedding buffer before LLM decode, derive deterministic pooled MVC-Q0 descriptors and optionally a bounded MVC-Q1 linear projection/readout, then compare FULL_QWEN, current dedicated-feature MVC baseline, QNDRF feature reuse, QNDRF ROI/token-budget and action-grounded-memory variants. On escalation, prove whether the already-computed mtmd embeddings can be passed into the same Qwen decode without rerunning visual encoding. Treat visual sensor origin as independent from Frank's server embodiment. Frozen screenshot/crop fixtures may be local files for deterministic compute-path tests; every live screen/camera/browser source must enter through secure transport -> API token authentication -> request/session/provenance binding -> typed multimodal ingress. Never persist raw production token values. Separate transport/auth/API-ingress latency from on-VPS Retina/Qwen latency and also measure the complete client/sensor-to-Frank outcome path. Preserve exact target-host, accepted binary/state identity where available, API contract/session identity, source/model/mmproj hashes, image token counts, frame/ROI identity, CPU/RAM/swap/storage/network and GPU/VRAM only if actually present, false-familiarity/open-set metrics, task/action outcome correctness and crash/replay receipts.
payload.reason_clay: Fresh primary evidence shows Qwen3.5-4B is already natively multimodal; Transformers exposes get_image_features before text decoding; llama.cpp libmtmd exposes encoded media embeddings and current llama-server feeds that same embedding buffer into the LLM. Existing target-host evidence proves the Hostinger VPS can execute a real local 4B Qwen-family model. The owner-fixed target is now a server-binary Frank identity running on this VPS with a full token-authenticated API. Therefore the accepted Retina architecture cannot stop at a local file or runner path: deterministic frozen fixtures test vision mechanics, while final live multimodal evidence must cross the same authenticated typed API boundary used by the server entity. Counterevidence from multimodal embedding research still means raw generative-VLM features cannot be assumed to be calibrated prototype/open-set embeddings, so a matched dedicated-feature baseline remains mandatory.
payload.completion_clay: A reproducible target-VPS report and raw rows compare all frozen visual variants and separately verify the accepted live multimodal API path. It measures secure transport/auth/session/ingress where applicable, mmproj encode cost, 4B decode cost and total sensor/client-to-decision cost; proves or falsifies zero-duplicate visual encoding; reports familiar/unknown/ambiguous/conflict calibration; measures ROI/context failure modes including off-ROI modal changes and small-text OCR; verifies invalid/missing/revoked credentials cannot reach the Frank perceptual path; verifies request/session/provenance identity survives to VisualPercept/response receipts; performs stale feature-version and service crash/restart tests; and gives SUPPORTED, REVISE, REFUTED or NO_CHANGE disposition for deleting a separate heavy visual backbone. Target-VPS rows are final-target architecture evidence but do not by themselves grant H1/H2/H3 or BASE release credit.
payload.executor_policy: Execute primary performance/correctness on the current Hostinger target VPS. Do not describe target-VPS rows as proxy evidence. If the target VPS has no GPU, that is the real v0.1 constraint unless the owner explicitly migrates the accepted target or authorizes a measured accelerator architecture. Use frozen visual fixtures to isolate compute-path effects; use the full token-authenticated API for live multimodal acceptance. Never emit or store raw production API tokens in repo/log artifacts. Refresh canonical/head, active work, target-host identity, server-binary/API directive, model/runtime versions and official llama.cpp multimodal API before effect. No paid training. No model promotion from generic benchmarks alone.
invalidators: Project owner explicitly changes the final Frank v0.1 target/identity/API contract
A newer owner-fixed visual architecture explicitly supersedes dissolved perception or MVC requirements
A newer target-VPS execution receipt already proves the same Qwen-feature-reuse and API-ingress differential on the current model/mmproj/runtime
Current Frank model/runtime no longer uses a Qwen3.5 multimodal path compatible with libmtmd feature interception
